lyrics:
[Intro: underwater hum, slow detuned chords]

[Verse 1: slowed female voice, pitched slightly down]
Lights are on beneath the blue
Just us, nobody new
Toes on the edge where the tile turns dark
Count it down, let go of the wall

[Build: chords rising, snare roll, voice repeating]
Into the deep, into the deep

[Drop: huge swelling synth chords, half-time beat, vocal chops]
Deep end (deep end)
Deep, deep end

[Verse 2: voice closer, bass sustaining]
Can't touch the floor, I don't care
Your shoulder's there, your shoulder's there
All the shallow years I spent
Holding on to cement

[Build: chords rising, snare roll, voice repeating]
Into the deep, into the deep

[Drop: bigger swell, bell melody on top]
Deep end (deep end)
Deep, deep end

[Outro: chords dissolve, water, a whisper]
I've got you.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 80 BPM half-time, 4/4, E major. Slow, vast and romantic, with a drop that swells like a deep breath.

VOICE: Female, a bright pop voice slowed and pitched down a little so it sounds dreamy and androgynous. She sings short phrases only. In the drops her voice is chopped and echoed. One natural whisper at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: Massive detuned saw-synth chords that swell in and out with the kick, a deep sub bass, a slow, heavy kick with a wide snare on the third beat, a glassy bell melody in the second drop, filtered white-noise sweeps, an underwater hum.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, hum and chords. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:44 Build. 0:56 Drop 1. 1:26 Verse 2. 1:54 Build. 2:06 Drop 2, with bells. 2:40 Outro, chords dissolve, the whisper at 2:54.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2013 future garage and early future bass: warm, saturated and enormous in the drops, quiet and close in the verses.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first swell at 0:56, when the chords open and the beat halves.

STATION FIT: 10 p.m., night swim. The slowest and biggest-sounding track of the night set, used the way a film uses a love theme.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hesitant, counting down, weightless, held.
